data.browserLocation: In this browser on this device. Clearing the site data for this page deletes it too.
data.appDataLocation: In the app's data on this computer.
data.folderLocation: Requests and environments are files in {{path}}. History, cookies, tokens and secret values are in the app's data on this computer.
data.backupsHintDesktop: A copy of the app's data is made the first time a new version starts and at most once a day. The last 10 are kept next to it. Secret values are stored apart from it, in the system keychain when there is one, and are not copied.
data.backupsHintBrowser: A copy of the data in this browser is made when the app opens, at most once a day and when a new version starts. The last 10 are kept in this browser, so clearing its site data deletes them too. Export to keep a copy elsewhere.
data.folderBackupsNote: The open workspace folder is plain files, so it is not copied here. Commit it to Git to keep its history.
data.restoreMessageDesktop: Replace the app's data with the backup from {{date}} ({{version}})? The collection saved on this computer, history, cookies, global variables and network settings go back to that copy. Workspace folders and secret values are not changed. A backup of the current data is made first, so you can undo this.
data.restoreMessageBrowser: Replace the data in this browser with the backup from {{date}} ({{version}})? Requests, folders, environments, history and cookies go back to that copy. A backup of the current data is made first, so you can undo this.
data.backupUnreadable: This backup cannot be read, so nothing was changed.
data.openBackupsFailed: Could not open the backups folder
data.browserStorageFullUsage: There is no room left in this browser's storage for Gostman. Gostman uses {{usage}} of the {{quota}} this browser allows for this site. If that is far from full, the disk itself is nearly full. Make large bodies smaller or delete requests you no longer need. The desktop app saves to a file and has no such limit.
data.browserStorageFull: There is no room left in this browser's storage for Gostman. This browser does not let Gostman use its database here, as in some private windows, so the data is kept in local storage, which holds only a few megabytes. Make large bodies smaller or delete requests you no longer need. The desktop app saves to a file and has no such limit.
data.browserStorageFullNoUsage: There is no room left in this browser's storage for Gostman. Make large bodies smaller or delete requests you no longer need. The desktop app saves to a file and has no such limit.
data.tabsNotStoredNoUsage: Your open tabs and their unsaved changes could not be stored, so they will be gone after a reload. Make the body smaller, or save the request and close its tab.
data.tabsNotStoredUsage: Your open tabs and their unsaved changes could not be stored, so they will be gone after a reload. Gostman uses {{usage}} of the {{quota}} this browser allows for this site. If that is far from full, the disk itself is nearly full. Make the body smaller, or save the request and close its tab.
data.tabsNotStored: Your open tabs and their unsaved changes could not be stored, so they will be gone after a reload. The storage for open tabs holds only a few megabytes, and a very large body fills it. Make the body smaller, or save the request and close its tab.
data.tabsUnreadable: The open tabs saved in this browser could not be read.
data.databaseUnavailable: This browser's database, where your Gostman data is kept, could not be opened. Close other Gostman tabs or restart the browser, then try again.
data.damagedDataKeptDatabase: The saved data in this browser could not be read, so the app started empty. The unreadable copy was kept in this browser's IndexedDB, in the "gostman" database, under "{{key}}".
data.damagedDataKeptLocal: The saved data in this browser could not be read, so the app started empty. The unreadable copy was kept in this browser's local storage under "{{key}}".
data.exportReminderHint: Your collection lives only in this browser. Export it to keep a copy somewhere else.
data.exportHint: Save your collection and environments to a file you can import later.
